title: lastrea mollissima
intro: Lastrea mollissima, commonly known as the Soft Fern, is a type of fern plant belonging to the family Dryopteridaceae. It is native to tropical and subtropical regions, and is valued for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and lower blood pressure. The therapeutic actions of Lastrea mollissima include its antioxidant, antimicrobial, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress, infection, and tissue damage. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
